steps.name: scoped-source-and-choice
steps.path: procurement source resolver -> C08 case -> C09 choice
steps.invariant: authentic issued procurement source, immutable recorded choice, conditioned coverage remains pending

steps.name: human prepare
steps.invariant: ui decisions.prepare-changes, exact operation in choice, current source and principal, plan save-estimate only; no domain mutation

steps.name: original source capture
steps.invariant: physical incarnation/current scope and real C02 projection persisted as evidence original, no mock receipt; pre patch skipped because preparation rejected

steps.name: persist prepared change
steps.invariant: C12 PreparedCommand version/idempotencyKey/commandDigest and target evidence; cloned domain preview, no receipt

steps.name: before/after review
steps.invariant: current source reissued; exact before/after; digest bounded to 5min and same principal/source, no grant

steps.name: human apply + atomic domain receipt
steps.invariant: distinct UI decisions.apply admission, genuine Requests.save and original CommandReceipt in one C08 transaction, application intent reserved; no global transaction

steps.name: reconcile case
steps.invariant: receipt principal/target/key/digest classified after durable domain commit; case receipt can reconcile later without replaying effect

steps.name: Atlas consume
steps.invariant: real scanner+outbox settled receipt, partition.originals and captureDigests linked to same case/owner; memory read authorized and source continuity rechecked

behaviors.identical_retry: C08 same key+digest reads original durable receipt; no second Requests.save; case-only reconciliation permitted
behaviors.different_content: receiptProof transaction key or commandDigest collision -> conflict; no new domain effect
behaviors.missing_receipt: recover returns unavailable/original-receipt-unavailable, never guesses or executes new command
behaviors.ambiguous_intent: an existing application intent with absent receipt blocks redispatch; requires reconciliation
behaviors.revoked: fresh UI principal/grant/source/roleMap revalidation fails closed before output, even on retry or historical read
behaviors.stale: source scope/version/physical incarnation/choice and frozen prepared CAS drift fails; no auto-reprepare
behaviors.pending_approval: a draft estimate remains unapproved, conditioned comparison remains conditioned, submit_pr and holder approval are separate workflows
behaviors.memory: fixture observation alone is insufficient; original capture+event+scanner+outbox must exist in production

limitations: No execution or CI; all behaviors traced as source invariants, not observed new C pass
No installed corporate provider/grant or Atlas scanner success claimed from synthetic local fixture
Source review does not satisfy independent final three release approvals
